Data Scientist - NLP
HealthStack builds AI tools for hospitals. We need a Data Scientist to work on clinical language models.

You will:
- Build and evaluate NLP and machine learning models on clinical text
- Train and fine-tune deep learning models
- Deploy models with the engineering team

Required:
- 3+ years in data science or machine learning
- Python and machine learning fundamentals
- Experience with NLP
Preferred:
- PyTorch or TensorFlow
- Hugging Face transformers
- SQL, Spark
- Healthcare domain

Location: Hyderabad or fully remote.

requirements.title: Data Scientist
requirements.summary: Data scientist building NLP and ML models on clinical text.
